summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing approximately $120 million in year-to-date orders from operators in India, up from $86 million reported in May. The orders support 4G/5G network expansion and include microwave and millimeter wave solutions. This is a routine business update regarding customer bookings, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is purely operational and sales-related.
